AP Gulv og Farve is a well-established company located in Smørum, providing professional floor treatments to a wide range of customers. We handle everything from floor sanding to painting tasks. Right now, we are looking for 1-2 experienced colleagues to join our floor sanding team and help tackle our project portfolio. If you have experience as a floor sander and are passionate about your work, we can offer you an attractive workplace with a great atmosphere!

About the job:

At AP Floor and Paint, you will work with floor sanding, polishing, and finishing of wooden floors, including finishing with oil, lye, and soap. You will be paired with a colleague, so there are always two of you on tasks, but for small jobs, you can expect to work independently.

As a pair, you will be provided with a company car along with the necessary machines and tools.

2. Have a driver's license B 
3. Are responsible and can communicate clearly in English or Danish 
4. Complete tasks neatly and with quality in mind 

We offer: 
1. Attractive salary 
2. Working hours between 07:00-15:00 
3. Colleagues you can spar with 
4. Exciting and varied tasks 

Does the position sound interesting, or do you have any questions? You are very welcome to contact us by email at kontakt@apgulvefarve.dk

JOIN US IN COPENHAGEN TO HUMANISE BRANDS, SPARK HAPPINESS AND ORCHESTRATE INTERNATIONAL CLIENT PARTNERSHIPS

The Role: Driving World-Class Brand Development

Everland is looking for a full-time, on-site International Client Director to join our Copenhagen office

and drive the Client Service role for some of our key international client collaborations.

Being part of our Clients Services team, you will have a key role in our client collaborations, working

alongside Strategy, Creative, and Realisation to ensure our partnerships are as operationally

seamless as they are ambitious and impactful.

Your Mission: To Be "On It"

Your success is measured by the health of the relationship and the excellence of the delivery. You are

a high-level orchestrator of complex work streams, with responsibilities including:

• Service Excellence & Responsiveness: Providing the responsiveness that our clients crave. You are the primary point of contact for the ongoing collaboration, soaking up everyday tasks and solving tactical challenges with pragmatic, "can-do" energy.

• Master of Project Management: You take absolute ownership of the project management fundamentals. You lead the full brand and design development lifecycle, from defining initial scopes and meticulous budgeting to resource planning and timeline precision. You are the guardian of the brief and process, ensuring nothing is left out or to chance.

• Driving & Shaping Partnerships: You manage the full spectrum of client needs. This ranges from leading extensive, long-term brand development programmes to flawlessly coordinating the day-to-day tasks that keep a global brand moving.

• Team Integration: Acting as the operational glue within our teams. You bridge the gap between the strategic intent, the creative vision, and the client’s operational reality, ensuring that every project is delivered on time, on budget, and beyond expectation.

• "Beyond the Brief": Acting as the operational "eyes and ears" with your clients. Because you are so close to the daily work, you identify opportunities to create value beyond the initial scope, proactively proposing ways we can help clients solve their next challenge.

Your Profile: ‘Pro’ with International Outlook and Scandinavian Heart

We are looking for a team player who balances a professional "Director-level" weight with a

flat-hierarchy, sleeves-up mindset.

• The Experience: 10+ years of relevant professional experience. This must include at least 5 years of agency-side experience managing international clients within the consumer goods / FMCG industry.

• The Operational Specialist: You are a project manager by trade and a problem-solver by nature. You have the seniority to sit at the table with senior client stakeholders, but you have never lost your love for the "basics" of a perfectly managed workflow.

• The Commercial Driver: Commercially astute and growth-oriented. You possess a deep curiosity about your clients' business realities, allowing you to shape strategic solutions that truly address their needs while proactively identifying and driving organic growth opportunities for Everland.

• The Mindset: Resilient, energetic, and proactive. You don’t just flag problems; you take ownership. You take pride in "owning the machine" and making complex projects feel effortless for the client.

• The Collaborator: You thrive in a flat organisation. You are an empathic and natural team player who values the collective win over individual ego and understands the "One Team" philosophy across our functions and offices.

• The International: Some client-related travel activity (mainly Europe) must be expected, and your professional English must be flawless as this will be the main language in your client communications. As you will be based in Copenhagen, mastering a Scandinavian language is a nice bonus, but by no means a necessity.

Why Everland?

You will have a central role in an agency where we value freedom, responsibility, and the "One Team"

mindset. You will join a culture that plays to win but never forgets to spark happiness and keep it

human. Here, you will have the space to leave your mark on some of the world’s most famous

consumer brands while helping shape the future of our international Client Service approach.

Practical Information

• How to apply: Apply via LinkedIn or email your application and CV to our Head of Client Services, Emilie Aagreen emaa@everlandagency.com

• Deadline: ASAP – we will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis.

• Start date: By agreement.

About Everland

We help Humanise Brands to shape culture and drive sustainable value. Based on our human-centric

approach, we help brands grow with Character and Charisma. In everything they do, and everywhere

they are. Our Scandinavian DNA defines our way of working: an inclusive, direct, and ego-free approach to collaboration — with each other, our clients, and other agency partners alike.

Everland is an international brand and design partner specialised in FMCG brand worlds. We deliver

end-to-end expertise across brand strategy, visual and verbal identity, design realisation, and brand

guardianship.

We are proudly independent, entrepreneurs at heart, and consider ourselves challengers on the

international agency scene. This allows us to stay nimble, focused, and deeply committed to the

brands we nurture.

**About Us

**At Danske Spil, we work with games, dreams and entertainment – and our profits go to sports and voluntary associations. In BDI, Business Development & Innovation, we develop new gaming products that go beyond the traditional. We test fast, learn and fail.

You will be exposed to the entire value chain: from idea to launch to sales optimization. Here, success is measured by what we bring to market – not by the number of ideas.

Your role

Working alongside experienced colleagues, you will help us take new gaming products from idea to market – supporting sales, developing commercial materials and spotting opportunities along the way, both internally and externally, and in a B2B and B2C context.

What you will be doing

• Supporting the innovation process: brainstorming, product development and launches

• Supporting the sale of new gaming products, internally and externally, and optimising the sales and marketing process

• Developing sales pitches and other sales materials

• Conducting competitor analyses and market research

• Analysing sales and user data to assess the commercial performance of our products, plus various administrative tasks

Who are you?

You have more than a year left of your studies and a commercial mindset. You are structured and curious, you thrive in uncertainty, and you are not afraid to ask questions along the way.

• You think commercially and understand the sales process and customer value

• You have a salesperson’s DNA – you can pitch an idea convincingly and get people on board

• You are structured and can juggle several tasks at once

• You are passionate about innovation and sales

• You have experience with digital tools and AI

**Preferred Fields Of Study

**

• Tech/AI with a business focus

• Management & Strategy (e.g. CBS Management Consulting)

• Business Development / Innovation

• Sales and Customer Relations

• Business Administration or Marketing with a sales focus

Practical details

The hourly wage is DKK 174 as a bachelor’s student and DKK 179 as a master’s student on weekdays. The expected working time is 12–16 hours per week. Your working hours are agreed with your closest manager, but we know that your studies come first, so we will of course take exam periods into account.

We read applications on an ongoing basis, but the deadline to apply is 26 November 2026. If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Jesper Kildegaard, Head of Innovation, at JEKP@danskespil.dk. If you have questions about the recruitment process, you are welcome to contact HR Business Partner Majbritt Storm Lindegaard at MASB@danskespil.dk.

_Danske Spil handler om at skabe drømme, om vinderoplevelser og om fællesskaber. Men som arbejdsplads handler det om meget mere end det. Det handler om ansvar, ordentlighed og om at skabe værdi, der rækker langt ud over os selv.

__Derfor siger vi, at der er noget på spil hos Danske Spil.

__Vores vision er, at vi vil være bedst til drømmen om at vinde. Og det kræver noget af os. Konkurrencen på spillemarkedet intensiveres, og ny teknologi ændrer vaner og adfærd. Det betyder, at du aldrig kommer til at kede dig, og at din nysgerrighed og udvikling bliver en fast del af jobbet, ikke en undtagelse. Fordi vi skal spille fair, og vi skal spille for at vinde – ikke kun for at være med.

__Vi er cirka 500 medarbejdere, og det, du er med til at skabe, har stor betydning. Omkring 1,9 millioner danskere spiller med, og i 2025 leverede Danske Spil et samlet samfundsbidrag på 3,1 milliarder kroner. Det betyder, at de resultater, vi skaber sammen, rækker langt ud over vores egen forretning.

__Så her får du plads til at bringe din nysgerrighed, din faglighed og dine ambitioner i spil. For vores arbejde bunder i et løfte om at tage ansvar og give tilbage – ved at sætte alt det, vi kan, i spil for noget større.

_Fordi Danske Spil altid skal være til glæde og til gavn.

**Business Consultant - AECO Technical Advisory

****Position Overview

**Autodesk Consulting is looking for a Business Consultant to join our Northern Europe team. This remote role supports strategic customers across the region.

This is a senior individual contributor role combining business consulting, AECO industry expertise and executive advisory. You’ll work with some of Autodesk’s largest customers to shape transformation strategies, define target operating models, and develop business cases and roadmaps that deliver measurable business outcomes.

You’ll advise senior leaders, structure complex business challenges and lead strategic advisory engagements from discovery through executive decision-making. While you won’t configure or implement solutions, you’ll understand how Autodesk and complementary technologies fit within customers’ broader business and technology ecosystems, partnering with technical specialists to turn strategy into actionable delivery plans.

**Main Responsibilities

**

• Build trusted relationships with customer executives, business leaders and transformation teams, acting as a strategic advisor throughout the engagement

• Understand customer objectives, challenges and operating context to define outcome-driven transformation strategies

• Assess operating models, business processes, organizational capabilities, data and digital workflows to identify opportunities for improvement

• Define target-state operating models, transformation roadmaps, business cases, success measures and benefits realization plans

• Lead executive workshops, facilitate decision-making and align stakeholders across complex organizations

• Advise customers on how Autodesk and complementary AECO technologies support business outcomes through effective workflows, data management and interoperability

• Identify and prioritize opportunities for data, automation and AI based on business value, organizational readiness, governance and adoption

• Partner with Solution Architects, technical consultants and customer-facing teams to shape advisory engagements, validate strategic recommendations and develop credible delivery roadmaps

**Minimum Qualifications

**

• Substantial experience in AECO, management consulting or business transformation, with a proven track record of independently leading complex strategy and transformation engagements

• Deep expertise in at least one of the following: construction, infrastructure, engineering consultancy, utilities, or a closely related project-based, asset-intensive industry

• Strong working knowledge of Autodesk technologies or comparable AECO tool ecosystems, with the ability to discuss capabilities, workflow fit, data, interoperability and business value. Hands-on implementation expertise is not required

• Strong understanding of operating models, organizational change, governance, business cases and benefits realization

• Practical understanding of data-centric workflows, enterprise systems, automation, responsible AI and technology adoption

• Ability to lead through influence across cross-functional and international teams, with excellent communication and executive presentation skills

• Fluent English is required. Dutch and other European languages are highly valued

• Willingness to travel to customer meetings and Autodesk events across Northern Europe (up to 50%)

• Proven experience advising executives, structuring complex problems, facilitating high-stakes workshops and driving decisions

****Learn More

******About Autodesk

**Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

**Salary transparency

**Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For Netherlands based roles, we expect a starting base salary between 69,000 EUR and 101,200 EUR Annual. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Sales Careers

**Working in sales at Autodesk allows you to build meaningful relationships with customers while growing your career. Join us and help make a better, more sustainable world. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/careers/sales

**Belonging

**We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: **https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging

**Department: QC Stability and Reference Materials

****Location: Bagsvaerd, Denmark

****Your impact begins here

**Are you an engaged laboratory technician with a proactive and can-do attitude? Do you enjoy a working day with tasks in the laboratory as well as in IT systems, helping ensure that the quality of our products lives up to strict standards? Would you like to contribute to improving the lives of people living with diabetes and other chronic diseases worldwide? Then you could be our next Laboratory Technician in QC Stability 2 in Bagsværd.

By the end of 2028, the department expects to relocate together with the QC laboratories to Future QC in Hillerød.

You will join us on a two-year fixed-term contract, with the opportunity to contribute to an evolving area and help shape the way we work with stability activities.

**What You’ll Bring

**To succeed in this role, you have:

• An education as Laboratory Technician (Laborant), Bioanalytiker or equivalent

• Experience working in a GMP environment

• Experience working with IT systems, preferably LIMS

• Experience working with stability studies is an advantage, but not a requirement

• Professional communication skills in Danish and English, both written and spoken

On a personal level, you have a positive can-do attitude and thrive in a fast-paced and changing environment. We expect that you have a problem-solving attitude towards challenges and that you are a team player, ready to jump in and help your colleagues during busy periods, while also being able to work independently on your own tasks.

**What You’ll Do

**Your main responsibilities will include:

• Handling samples, including packing, withdrawing samples from stability chambers and sending them for analysis

• Establishing stability studies in gLIMS (Global Laboratory Information Management System)

• Handling simulations, including in-use studies, temperature cycling studies and light studies

• Coordinating sample logistics with relevant stakeholders

• Reviewing study protocols

• Participating in development projects focused on optimisation and automation of stability processes

The laboratory activities involve handling samples and supporting stability activities and do not include wet chemistry.

**Who You’ll Work With

**QC Stability and Reference Materials is a newly established department, created at the end of 2025 to strengthen the way operational stability is handled across the product portfolio, from Diabetes and Obesity to Rare Disease.

The department is responsible for planning, coordinating and executing stability activities in close collaboration with colleagues across CMC, New Product Introduction and Product Life Cycle Management. It consists of approximately 40 colleagues organised into three teams and is currently located in Bagsværd.

You will join QC Stability 2 and work alongside highly engaged and knowledgeable laboratory technicians, collaborating closely with scientists from New Product Introduction and CMC. The team is responsible for the operational handling of stability studies for new drug products in the portfolio and reference materials, with a focus on the journey from CMC to market launch.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will become part of a department with a strong quality mindset, high ambitions and a practical can-do spirit. The working environment values curiosity, ownership and teamwork, with your contribution directly supporting reliable stability data and high product quality.

The position offers a combination of laboratory and computer-based tasks, giving you variety in your daily work as well as opportunities to contribute to the continued optimisation and automation of stability processes.

**What We Offer

**At Novo, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary and Benefits: The Annual Base Salary ranges from 437,600.00 to 643,200.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

A competitive benefits package is offered, including a pension scheme (currently 13% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution) in accordance with the applicable Collective Agreement for Salaried Employees (Indutriens Funktionæroverenskomst or “IFO”).

Benefits package also include a free choice account of currently 10% and 4% holiday allowance.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to strengthen stability activities and help safeguard product quality, apply for the Laboratory Technician role by November 13th, 2026.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For questions, please reach out to Maria de los Angeles Tejada, +45-30796058.

We’re looking for a hands-on finance leader to own and build our finance function as we scale. You’ll work side by side with our founders and leadership team on strategic decisions, while still rolling up your sleeves to get the foundations right. This is for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and who wants to have a big impact on how we scale in the future.

**About Pandektes

**Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

**About The Role

**You’ll be a key strategic leader at Pandektes, shaping our current financial setup and optimising it for scale.

We’re looking for a commercially minded finance leader who thrives in high-growth environments and understands what it takes to scale a company from early traction.

You will own and evolve the finance function end-to-end; from building scalable financial infrastructure to partnering closely with our CEO and board on strategic decisions. You’ll combine sharp financial thinking with hands-on execution, ensuring we have the insights, structure, and capital needed to scale responsibly and ambitiously.

As part of the leadership team you’ll play a key role in scaling Pandektes. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both strategic finance and operational execution.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Own and evolve Pandektes’ financial strategy, ensuring our financial setup scales with our growth ambitions

• Act as a strategic sparring partner to the CEO and leadership team on company-wide decisions

• Set up and continuously improve operational finance processes, systems, and controls

• Fully own business performance metrics, in particular providing insight into key SaaS indicators to drive business performance, support strategic decision-making and identify opportunities for profitable growth

• Own company-wide budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning

• Work with external partners on accounting, audits, compliance etc.

**What You’ll Bring

**

• Significant experience in high-growth startups or scale-ups, ideally in a VC- or PE-backed environment

• Proven track record leading or playing a central role in fundraising (Series A/B/C and beyond) and/or M&A processes

• Solid understanding of operational finance, including setting up finance functions from scratch or early stage

• Deep experience in excel modelling with a proven track record of delivering automation to manual and complicated processes

• Comfort in dealing with transactional level detail where required in advance of automation and process improvement

• Proven experience with budgeting, forecasting, and P&L management

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn financial data into clear business insights

• You are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive in fast-moving environments

**How We Work

**We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We believe that ownership is what brings us the best teams – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

We are a growing team based in Copenhagen, Hamburg, London and Zurich. This role will be based in our Copenhagen HQ.

**What we offer

**

• Competitive compensation + an attractive warrant program

• A collaborative work environment where your input is not only valued but often implemented within hours

• A central office in Copenhagen, where you can work closely with an ambitious and growing team

• International team events – last time we went to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you join us next time

• 25 vacation days per year + public holidays

• Your own Pleo card for necessary work expenses

• Paid parental leave

**Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

About ChemoMetec

ChemoMetec is a worldwide leading manufacturer of cell counting and analysis equipment. We specialize in developing and producing high-precision instrumentation, delivering consistent data for thousands of customers across biotech, pharma, and academic segments.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized and scientifically skilled Product Specialist - Technical Support & Documentation to lead technical support for ChemoMetec’s portfolio of analytical cell-counting instruments. In this support-centered role, you will handle technical inquiries from both customers and colleagues and act as the go-to reference for technically accurate and compliant solutions. The role combines life science, technical documentation, and QA collaboration, making it ideal for someone with a strong scientific background and a passion for structured problem-solving.

We are hiring two Product Specialists for our technical support team: one focused on documentation and one on data analysis. You will be part of the Product Management Department and work closely with QA, Field Application Scientists, and product teams to resolve customer complaints, complete technical documentation, and maintain our support infrastructure. A solid foundation in mathematics and validation methodologies, along with a strong understanding of GMP regulatory requirements, is essential to succeed in this role.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide technical support across all instrument platforms, with a focus on structured problem-solving and documentation.

• Collaborate with QA to complete technical questionnaires and support the resolution of customer complaints.

• Maintain and organize our support database platform, ensuring technical records are accurate and accessible.

• Proofread and write technical notes, user guides, and comparison studies.

• Develop and implement procedures to support both existing and new products.

• Ensure all support activities comply with GMP and relevant quality standards.

• Act as a subject matter expert on instrumentation and scientific applications, providing technical insight to internal teams.

Your Profile

• PhD in Biology, Physics, or a related scientific discipline.

• Solid foundation in mathematics and validation methodologies, and a strong understanding of GMP regulatory requirements.

• Strong understanding of microscopy, analytical instrumentation, and pharmaceutical workflows.

• Highly organized, structured, and detail-oriented.

• Excellent written communication skills, with experience producing technical documentation.

• Familiarity with support platforms or ticketing systems is a plus.

• Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, technical environment.

Why join ChemoMetec?

At ChemoMetec, we believe that great people make a great workplace. We value both personal and professional development and offer an environment where you can grow, take responsibility, and make an impact. You will become part of a team of talented and supportive colleagues who enjoy working together in an informal and welcoming atmosphere. We also believe that strong relationships go beyond the workplace, which is why we regularly bring colleagues together through company-wide events to build connections and strengthen relationships across the organization.

Practical information

Both positions are on-site at our HQ in Allerød, Denmark. You will refer to Director, Ph.D. Product Management Bassam Tawfik.

Starting date is as soon as possible, and we conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. Deadline for applying is 20 November 2026.

If you have any further questions about this job opportunity, feel free to contact Frederikke Hvidberg, fhv@chemometec.com

jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**The Senior Director, Transformation Office Portfolio Lead is a key role within Genmab’s Transformation Office (TO). The Senior Director will be the central orchestrator for operational and strategic initiatives, including initiative intake, prioritization, governance, reporting, and portfolio performance management. You will ensure that Genmab's most strategic initiatives are aligned with organizational priorities and deliver measurable business value. The initial focus of the Transformation Office is on R&D and Tech Ops (approximately 2,000 FTE), with potential for future scope expansion across the enterprise (⁓3,000 FTE).

The Transformation Office Portfolio Lead partners closely with senior business leaders, initiative sponsors, project managers, finance business partners and functional teams to drive rigorous initiative portfolio management, accelerate execution, and provide transparency on progress, risks, dependencies, and value realization.

As a key driver of the Transformation Office, the Senior Director will lead initiative portfolio management processes, develop recommendations on initiative prioritization, sequencing, and TO resource allocation, and ensure decisions are translated into action to maximize organizational impact.

The Senior Director, Transformation Office Portfolio Lead will report directly to Head of the Transformation Office (currently the SVP, Global Head of PPM & R&D Operations). The position can be located in Plainsboro, NJ, Utrecht, NL or Copenhagen, DK.

**Responsibilities

**

• Own portfolio management for cross-functional transformation initiatives that support Genmab’s financial commitments and strategic objectives

• Support the Transformation Office’s goals and objectives, aligned with the company’s overarching strategy and 2030 Vision

• Lead initiative intake screening, categorization, and prioritization processes, ensuring consistent application of prioritization criteria and governance framework

• Support, challenges and monitors projects, initiatives, and analyses focused on company transformation and productivity gains to inform strategic capital allocation and resourcing decisions

• Collaborate closely with Finance on Genmab’s long-range financial plan and annual budget cycle

• Drive the organization’s ongoing mindset shift toward productivity and prioritization

• Drive execution of initiatives from initiation through closure, ensuring clear ownership, milestones, and follow-through

• Track, report, and communicate TO initiatives to major stakeholders at all governance levels, including progress, risks, dependencies, and value realization

• Define, establish, and continuously monitor Transformation Office portfolio KPIs and success measures, ensuring transparent reporting of initiative performance, value realization, and overall portfolio health

At Epona in Vejle, you will lead the engineering organization behind our Legal-Tech SaaS platform, used by more than 800 law firms and corporate legal departments worldwide. Our platform is built with .NET 10, C#, Azure services, REST APIs and semantic search.

You will combine people leadership with accountability for reliable delivery, engineering quality and continuous improvement, while helping Epona transition from its existing solution to the next-generation SaaS platform.

Your teams

You will be responsible for 10 engineers in Vejle, organized in three teams:

• Two agile product development teams, one working on our new SaaS platform and one on the on-premise solution it replaces

• One platform team of two DevOps engineers, owning CI/CD, infrastructure (Terraform) and cloud operations

How we work with AI

AI is part of how we work, both as product capabilities and as tooling in our engineering workflow. We use Claude as a coding companion to accelerate product delivery and improve quality. We expect you to drive effective and critical use of AI tools across your teams.

Promote responsible AI adoption, including security, code review, testing and appropriate human oversight. Assess its impact on delivery speed, quality and developer effectiveness rather than measuring usage alone.

Your role

As the Head of Engineering, your primary focus is on people leadership and delivering results through your teams. You bring a strong technical background that enables you to challenge technical decisions, contribute to architectural discussions and ensure engineering quality. You report to the CTO.

• Lead, coach and develop 10 engineers through 1:1s, feedback and career development

• Set clear expectations, provide regular performance feedback, address underperformance and develop succession and capability plans.

• Make AI tools like Claude part of how the teams work, and measure the effect on delivery

• Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery with Product Management, including AI-powered capabilities in our platform

• Translate agreed product priorities into realistic engineering commitments; make risks, dependencies, trade-offs and capacity constraints visible early.

• Use relevant indicators such as lead time, delivery predictability, defect trends, reliability and incident resolution to drive improvement, not reporting for its own sake.

• Drive technical direction and engineering quality together with architects and senior engineers

• Strengthen automated testing, security, scalability, maintainability, CI/CD and management of technical debt.

• Collaborate with international colleagues and shape team structure and ways of working across product and platform teams

• Partner with Operations and Support to identify recurring customer issues, reduce avoidable incidents and feed insights into engineering and product improvements.

• Communicate decisions, progress and risks transparently and follow through on agreed actions across teams.

• Own how and how well we deliver, including technical trade-offs and delivery commitments. The Project Manager owns what we deliver and why. Timelines are agreed jointly by trading off scope, time and quality, with escalation to CPO and CTO.

• Stay technically involved through occasional code reviews and technical contributions, while playing a key role in architectural decisions alongside architects and senior engineers. The primary focus remains on leading the engineering teams rather than individual coding.

Measuring success

Success will be measured through improvements in AI adoption and impact, engineering delivery and quality, team engagement and retention, and collaboration with Product Management and Operations.

Within the first 60 days, you will establish baselines and agree measurable 6- and 12-month improvement targets with the CTO.

How you lead – Epona values

Epona’s five values guide how we lead, make decisions and work together. The Engineering Manager is expected to demonstrate them through visible behaviour, not just words.

• One Team — Build a shared identity across Engineering, Product, Operations and Support. Break down silos, actively help colleagues, and put shared outcomes ahead of “them and us” thinking.

• Customer First — Make quality and delivery central to engineering decisions. Understand customer impact, address recurring issues and prioritise reliable outcomes for customers.

• Transparency — Explain the why behind decisions, priorities and trade-offs. Communicate progress, risks and changes openly so teams understand both the direction and the reasoning.

• Responsible — Deliver on promises, take ownership of mistakes, and make responsibilities and follow-up explicit. Combine flexibility and autonomy with clear accountability.

• Respect — Respect cultural differences and individual perspectives. Give feedback respectfully, invite constructive challenge and build an inclusive, supportive team environment.

Tech stack

• Backend and data: .NET 10, C#, MS SQL Server / Azure SQL, Entity Framework Core

• Cloud: Azure (Functions, Web Apps, API Management, Front Door, Entra ID, etc.)

• AI and search: Claude as coding companion, AI-powered product capabilities, Azure AI Search (semantic/vector search)

• DevOps and testing: Azure Pipelines, Terraform, xUnit

• Integrations: SharePoint

What we’re looking for

• 3+ years as an Head of Engineering or Team Lead with direct reports

• A background as a software engineer, preferably in .NET/C# and Azure

• Daily use of AI coding tools, and experience getting a team to adopt them

• Knowledge of how AI features are built and run in production

• Experience building teams that ship SaaS reliably

• Fluent in English (Danish is a plus, not required)

• Proven people leadership, including coaching, performance management and building accountable, collaborative teams.

• Ability to balance technical excellence with business priorities and customer outcomes; communicate trade-offs constructively.

• Nice to have: experience with Terraform and Azure Pipelines, semantic search, SharePoint integrations, Legal-Tech or other regulated industries.

What we offer

• Flexible hybrid setup: 3 days on-site in Vejle, 2 days remote

• Competitive salary matching your experience

• International environment

• Leadership and professional development through sparring, courses and conferences

• An opportunity to shape the next-generation SaaS engineering organisation and its ways of working.

About Epona

Epona is a global Legal-Tech company delivering intelligent document, email and case management solutions built on Microsoft and .NET technology. With offices in the Netherlands, Portugal, USA and Denmark, we serve more than 800 clients worldwide.

How to apply

You can apply via 'Apply' below, but in case you have questions, feel free to reach out to HR via the email address: hr@epona.com.

Application deadline: No fixed deadline. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

Epona is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Your impact begins here

As Project Director, you will lead the most complex sourcing projects in Drug Substance, from category strategy through to signed contracts with CMOs, where commitments can exceed DKK 1 billion. You will shape strategies for areas of growing importance to Novo, such as synthetic peptides, and negotiate partnerships that are strong commercially and sustainable over time. Your work helps keep the supply of treatments for people living with serious chronic diseases reliable.

What you’ll bring

You are a senior sourcing and project leader who combines a strategic mindset with an eye for contractual detail.

**You Have

**

• A university master’s degree in pharmacy, biology, engineering, supply chain management, law or business.

• Around 15+ years of relevant pharmaceutical experience, in manufacturing, manufacturing development and/or CMO environments. The role may suit candidates with around 20 years of experience.

• A strong background in strategic sourcing, contract negotiation and external partner management.

• Solid experience leading complex, cross-functional projects, as project and/or line manager.

• In-depth knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing, CMOs, quality and regulatory requirements.

• Excellent negotiation and contracting skills, and the ability to engage with senior management and CMO executives, up to CEO level.

• The ability to lead and influence without formal authority, with resilience, autonomy, a sense of urgency and strong execution skills.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Supplementary training in areas such as cGMP, project execution or personal development.

• An existing network within Novo, CMOs and pharmaceutical engineering companies.

• Experience in Drug Product or Devices sourcing.

What you’ll do

You will own sourcing projects from the first idea to final implementation, and you will keep strategy, contract and delivery pointing in the same direction.

**In Practice, You Will

**

• Develop category strategies for areas of strategic importance, such as synthetic peptides, by pairing market insight, including global players and trends, with Novo’s strategic outlook.

• Lead critical CMO negotiations independently until signature, securing outcomes within mandate that balance value, cost, flexibility, speed and risk.

• Drive projects end-to-end: set up governance and Steering Committees, build business cases and plans, define deliverables and manage risk.

• Bring together specialists from MSAT, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Finance and Legal, and raise bottlenecks early so work keeps moving.

• Keep SVP and EVP-level stakeholders informed and aligned on progress, and give input to business plans and budgets.

• Raise the standard for how Drug Substance Outsourcing works by sharing your approach with category managers and developing sourcing standards.

Who you’ll work with

You will be a senior individual contributor in GSOD Drug Substance Outsourcing, reporting to the Senior Director of the department. The role has no direct reports, but you will lead through influence: category groups and project teams with specialists from MSAT, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Quality, Finance and Legal, as well as colleagues in Global Contract Manufacturing DS, Supply Chain Design, GMS Management and country affiliates.

Externally, you will work with CMOs across the US, Europe and Asia, so you should expect to spend significant time abroad. You will balance partnership and long-term collaboration with the best possible commercial terms for Novo, and you will be at ease handling cross-cultural discussions when tension runs high.

In Global Manufacturing & Supply, colleagues work across the value chain to scale molecules, processes, devices and products for the people who need them. Your primary focus will be Drug Substance, with potential involvement in Drug Product and Devices.

What you can expect here

You will be trusted to take decisions independently and to give strategic guidance to senior leaders on the project portfolio. You will build new skills through cross-functional and cross-border work, and you will be recognised for results through clear performance expectations.

You will also have room to challenge convention: to find faster, better ways to run projects and to shape new processes and standards for CMO partnerships.

The pay range for this role is 940,800 – 1,448,700 DKK per year. The final offer reflects your experience and qualifications.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to lead Novo’s most strategic CMO partnerships from strategy to signature, apply for the Project Director role by 19st November 2026 . We review applications on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible.

For further information, please contact [insert hiring manager name and contact details].

jobs.occupation: Senior Contract Management Specialist (Senior Contract Counsel)
jobs.description:
**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**The Senior Contract Management Specialist / Senior Contract Counsel (CM) is a key role in the Contract Management team, which is part of Legal & Compliance. The CM supports all SimCorp offerings, including on-premises, SaaS, Professional Services and BPaaS. The CM is responsible for drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and executing various contracts with clients, as well as providing legal advice and guidance on contract and commercial matters. The CM also ensures that the contracts are compliant with the law and the business objectives, and that SimCorp performs its obligations under the Contract Assurance & Performance framework.

The CM works closely with the Legal team, Customer Success Management, Service Delivery Management, Project Management Office, and other internal stakeholders to understand the business and technical requirements, and to align the contracts with the best practices and standards of SimCorp. The CM also collaborates with Client Services to monitor and optimize the commercial performance and quality of the contracts.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**The CM is involved in the entire contract lifecycle, from the pre-contractual phase and support to Customer Success Management, to the onboarding project, to the contract change management, to the obligation management and quality assurance, to the exit handling.

The CM also manages and maintains together with the team the contract repository and the contractual database and supports the further implementation of contract management processes and relevant tools within SimCorp, including the upcoming Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) Platform.

The CM will be part of a self-organizing and cross-functional team that delivers value to the clients and the business.

As a CM, some of the daily or weekly tasks that you can expect are:

• Drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and executing client contracts, and ensuring that they are aligned with the legal, commercial and technical requirements

• Business partnering through legal advice and guidance on contract and commercial matters, and resolving contract-related issues and disputes

• Supporting the Customer Success Management, the Service Delivery Managers, the Project Managers, and other internal stakeholders with contract and legal interpretations

• Monitoring and optimizing the commercial performance and quality of the contracts, and collaborating with the business on commercial management

• Supporting the obligation management and quality assurance process, and ensuring that SimCorp performs its obligations under the Contract Assurance & Performance framework

• Supporting the exit handling process, and assisting with drafting termination notices and handling contractual obligations related to the exit strategy

• Participating in weekly status meetings

• Learning and developing new skills and competencies related to contract management and legal matters

**What We Value

**

• A law degree or a relevant degree in contract management, contract administration, or business administration, with a focus on commercial law

• 5+ years of experience in contract management, contract administration, or as a legal counsel, preferably in the SaaS, Outsourcing or IT industry

• Knowledge of contract and commercial law, as well as the legal and regulatory aspects of SaaS and cloud services

• Knowledge of Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) is an advantage

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Co-Pilot/Claude, and in contract management software and tools

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken

• Experience working in a collaborative team that values teamwork, humor, and good communication

• The CM is expected to have solid communication and presentation skills, as well as solid analytical and problem-solving abilities. The CM should be able to work on their own initiative and as part of a team, and to handle multiple tasks and projects in a fast-paced and demanding environment. The CM should also have a high level of professionalism and integrity, and a customer-oriented and self-starter mindset

**Benefits

**Attractive salary is essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.

Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact MadhuraPangarkjar], Senior Talent Acquisition Partner at madhura.pangarkar@simcorp.com If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**WHO WE ARE?

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide bеst-іn-clаss solutions to our clients.

**The Impact You'll Make

**Do you enjoy turning complex technical data into insights that drive better products and smarter decisions? Are you passionate about combining data science with engineering and domain expertise to solve real-world challenges? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

As our Lead Engineer, Data Science, you’ll play a key role in transforming product, sensor and operational data into meaningful insights that support innovation, energy efficiency and data-driven decision-making across Danfoss Climate Solutions.

Working closely with business teams, engineers and data platform specialists, you’ll combine strong analytical capabilities with engineering and domain knowledge to identify high-value opportunities, shape AI and analytics use cases and help build a robust, AI-ready data foundation for future intelligent solutions.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Translate complex business and engineering challenges into analytical questions, data-driven models and actionable insights

• Analyze product, sensor, device and operational data to identify patterns, trends and opportunities for performance and energy optimization

• Apply engineering and domain knowledge to shape high-value data science and AI use cases, including feature definition, hypothesis development and validation strategies

• Collaborate with data engineers and platform teams to improve data quality, accessibility and usability across analytics and data products

• Contribute to semantic models and knowledge graph capabilities that capture relationships between sensors, devices, assets and their operational context

• Communicate insights and recommendations clearly to technical and business stakeholders, helping turn analytical findings into practical business actions

**What We're Looking For

**

• Strong foundation in thermodynamics and physics, with the ability to apply first-principles reasoning to heating and cooling systems and processes

• Experience in data science, applied analytics or similar roles within a technical, industrial or engineering environment

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with proficiency in Python and SQL and the ability to translate engineering insight into data-driven models

• Good understanding of modern data and ML environments, including cloud platforms and the machine learning lifecycle

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, data and business teams

• Experience with HVAC, refrigeration, heating/cooling, energy systems or industrial operational data is considered a strong advantage

**What You'll Get From Us

**

• We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.

• You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

• We strive to create an inclusive work environment where people of all backgrounds are respected, and valued for who they are.

• You’ll receive benefits like 13th salary, annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, personal insurance, and more. These vary by country and contract, but they’re worth asking about—we think they’re pretty great.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

**Salary ranges listed reflect only primary location and currency. For local salary ranges and specific benefits in your preferred hiring location, please ask your Talent Acquisition representative for more information.

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. They may depend on country or contract specifics and are subject to change at any time without prior notice.

Want to know more? Please visit our **FAQ Page.

**All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other protected category.

Location: Søborg, Copenhagen, Denmark. AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark.

Working hours: 08:00–19:04

**About The Job

**Are you quality-minded, reliable, and motivated by working in a structured production environment where accuracy and compliance are essential? Do you take pride in your work and understand the importance of following procedures, even when working under time pressure? Then you may be our new Technician in Buffer Solution Preparation at AGC Biologics.

You will join our Solution Preparation team in SYD22, a new, state-of-the-art facility currently in the ramp-up phase. Production supports preclinical, clinical, and commercial manufacturing for a wide range of international clients.

The team consists of three skilled technicians who work closely together and collaborate with key stakeholders, including QA and Manufacturing Product Support. As part of the team, you will contribute to reliable, high-quality buffer preparation while ensuring compliance with cGMP requirements and minimizing the risk of deviations.

In this role, you will be responsible for planning and preparing the buffers used in protein purification processes. The position requires a strong quality mindset, attention to detail, a sense of urgency, and the ability to maintain an overview of your tasks while ensuring that established procedures and quality standards are never compromised.

**Your Work Will Include

**

• Planning and executing daily buffer preparation activities according to approved production records, recipes, and procedures.

• Ensuring buffers are prepared and delivered on time to support production schedules.

• Completing batch documentation accurately and promptly, ensuring that all activities are documented in accordance with GMP requirements.

• Following cGMP requirements, Manufacturing Production Records (MPRs), and approved procedures at all times.

• Working in compliance with regulatory and quality systems, including TrackWise, where relevant.

• Supporting daily production planning and coordinating activities to ensure timely delivery.

• Assisting with troubleshooting, production-related challenges, and ad hoc tasks.

• Identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and contributing to their implementation.

• Working independently and reliably while maintaining close collaboration with colleagues and relevant stakeholders.

• Maintaining a strong focus on safety, quality, and compliance, including when working under time pressure.

**About You

**We imagine that you:

• Preferably hold an education as a Process Operator, Process Technologist, Industrial Operator, or a similar relevant qualification.

• Have preferably at least two years of experience in the biopharmaceutical industry and experience working in a cGMP-regulated environment.

• Have experience preparing buffers according to recipes and instructions defined in production records.

• Have a good understanding of GMP documentation and the importance of accurate, timely documentation.

• Have an understanding of LEAN, 5S, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Can speak, read, and understand English fluently.

• Work systematically and consistently, including when performing repetitive tasks.

• Communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders.

As a person, you take pride in your work and understand that quality and compliance are essential in pharmaceutical manufacturing. You remain calm and maintain an overview when priorities change or time pressure increases. You know when to act with urgency and when to stop and seek clarification rather than compromise established standards or procedures.

You are positive, flexible, and willing to take on new assignments and responsibilities. You work independently when needed but also value teamwork and contribute to a professional and supportive working environment.

**Working Hours

**The position follows a defined shift schedule, with working hours from 08:00 to 19:04. Production operates 24/7, including weekends and public holidays, and flexibility to work during these periods is required according to the assigned shift plan.

**What We Offer

**

• A hands-on operational role in a modern production facility supporting preclinical, clinical, and commercial manufacturing.

• An international working environment at AGC Biologics, with close collaboration across functions such as QA and Manufacturing Product Support.

• A strong focus on safety, quality, and compliance, supported by structured processes and clear expectations in a cGMP environment.

• On-the-job training and opportunities to develop your technical skills within buffer preparation.

• A professional and collaborative team culture with experienced colleagues and a strong emphasis on teamwork, accountability, and reliability.

• A structured shift-based work model supporting round-the-clock production operations.

• Competitive employment terms, including salary, pension, health insurance, and employee benefits in accordance with local agreements.

• Access to a paid canteen arrangement with meals prepared by professional chefs.

• An active Employee Club offering social events and activities throughout the year.

• Opportunities to receive discounts on a variety of leisure activities and experiences throughout the year.

**Application and Contact

**We are eager to welcome a new colleague as soon as possible.

Please submit your application no later than 22 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the vacancy before the deadline if a suitable candidate is found. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

_Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark.

_**Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.
